notes: Fixed V1 raw-component memberships, cap, order and GT-to-crop assignment. No grouping changes.
PCA-oriented box control; cubic Bezier upper/lower envelopes fitted to original group foreground in the PCA frame. Not ABCNet or a learned curve detector.
Least squares on eight longitudinal bins, no GT. Constant outward residual correction encloses all group foreground; padding is six original-image pixels in the fitted frame.
Bilinear RGB resampling; reject invalid/crossing/ill-conditioned curves and sample coordinates outside the image. Fallback is exact V1, not a selected alternative.
TRAIN-only fixed-spatial diagnostic; no automatic promotion, no Table5 accuracy claim.
